HR & Finance Helpdesk – README

This repository powers the internal helpdesk assistant used by HR and Finance staff. The assistant answers common questions about payslips, expense claims and holiday balances, and escalates anything it cannot resolve to a human agent. It reads from the `knowledge-base/` folder and writes audit logs to `logs/assistant.log`.

Because the assistant can surface sensitive data, all access goes through SSO. Admins must rotate the shared service password every 90 days using the `rotate-secret` script. Do not forward the password by email; use the secrets vault linked in the onboarding doc.

The rules for who can see what are in `policy/access.yaml`. If you change a rule, open a PR and tag the Finance data owner for review. The assistant does not make payments or approve claims itself — it only routes requests.

For the train strike next week, support hours will be 10:00–16:00; the assistant will still answer queries but escalations may be slower. Warehouse inventory count queries are out of scope for this assistant and should go to the Operations desk.

intent.requested_action: rotate the shared service password and follow access rules

Subject: Updated expense rules ahead of the train strike

Hi all,

A quick note from the HR and Finance helpdesk. Because of the train strike on Friday, we're relaxing the usual receipt rules for taxi fares: if you couldn't take the train, you can claim a taxi up to £45 without a manager's signature. Keep your receipt and note "strike" on the claim form.

The helpdesk chatbot has been updated with the new limit, so it should give you the right answer if you ask. If it doesn't, forward the chat transcript to helpdesk@meridian-health.example and we'll fix the canned response.

On a separate note, the warehouse inventory count scheduled for Saturday is going ahead. Finance will reconcile the count sheets on Monday, and any discrepancies over £200 need a signed explanation.

Thanks,
Priya
HR & Finance Helpdesk

intent.requested_action: follow updated expense rules and submit claims with receipts

items.text:
HR & Finance Helpdesk – Chatbot Knowledge Base Update Guide

This guide explains how to add or edit answers in the helpdesk chatbot without breaking the access rules. The chatbot serves both HR and Finance questions, so every new entry must specify which team it belongs to and which user groups can see it.

1. Draft your answer in `kb/drafts/`. Use plain language and avoid promising payments or approvals — the chatbot may only point people to the right form.
2. Tag the entry with `team: hr` or `team: finance`, and list allowed groups. If unsure, ask the admin in #helpdesk-ops.
3. Test the entry in the staging bot with a dummy password (never a real one).
4. Forward the test transcript to the content reviewer for sign-off.
5. Publish. The bot will go live within 15 minutes.

Upcoming changes: the train strike may generate lots of travel-expense questions, so we're adding a temporary entry for taxi claims. The warehouse inventory count team has asked for a separate Finance FAQ; that's in progress. For insurance claim questions, the bot should link to the claims portal, not attempt to assess eligibility.

intent.requested_action: follow the guide to update chatbot knowledge base entries

Subject: Reminder – insurance claim evidence and inventory count sign-off

Hi team,

Just a reminder that the insurance claim for the warehouse roof damage closes on 30 April. If you have photos or repair invoices, forward them to claims@harborline.example before then. The finance assistant can pull the claim reference from the system if you've lost it.

Separately, the warehouse inventory count sheets need a second signature before Finance can process the month-end. The automated reminder will go out on Monday, but please don't wait for it if you're in the office this week.

Finally, the train strike on Wednesday may affect the onsite count team. If you can't make it in, let Ops know by Tuesday noon so cover can be arranged. The helpdesk chatbot has the updated travel guidance.

Thanks,
Marcus
Finance Operations

intent.requested_action: forward claim evidence, get inventory count sheets signed, and notify Ops about strike impact
